head.text: BAD PERF -- read admit at HALF rate. The arm bit was cleared by its own admit and could only re-set the next cycle, so one sub-command (= one DRAM burst = one column here) admitted every TWO cycles. Ceiling 0.5 x 8 B x 75 MHz = 300 MB/s; measured 291.7 against 570 for writes. Integrity was perfect throughout -- this shape is the ONLY symptom.
